## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `docusign-dsadmin-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a DocuSign developer account

1. <!-- manual: If you do not already have a developer account, [sign up for free](https://go.docusign.com/o/sandbox/). -->

## Step 3: Create an integration key and secret key

1. <!-- manual: Log in to the [DocuSign Developer Portal](https://admindemo.docusign.com/apps-and-keys) and navigate to Apps and Keys. -->
2. Select **Add App and Integration Key**, enter a name, and select **Create App**. This generates an **Integration Key** (your `clientId`).
3. <!-- manual: Select Add App and Integration Key, enter a name, and select Create App. This generates an Integration Key (your clientId). -->
4. Under **Authentication**, select **Add Secret Key**. Copy and save the generated **Secret Key** (your `clientSecret`).

## Step 4: Add a redirect URI

1. On the same app configuration page, under **Additional settings**, select **Add URI**.
2. Enter your redirect URI (for example, `http://www.example.com/callback`).
3. <!-- manual: Enter your redirect URI (for example, http://www.example.com/callback). -->
4. <!-- manual: Save the changes. -->
